description: Fixed open box with a centre-drop probe. Outcome is judged in the BOX LOCAL frame so that support by the world floor can never be mistaken for a valid box floor.

provenance.dt_and_contact: engineering_baseline_v1 (handbook section 9), not calibrated against hardware
provenance.tolerances: engineering_baseline_v1; geometry tolerance from handbook G1
provenance.lighting_and_camera: evidence framing only, no physical meaning; two views so every expected resting place is visible

views.name: interior_top
views.purpose: look down into the cavity: shows a probe resting on the interior floor, or a lid sealing the opening

views.name: side_low
views.purpose: eye below the box's outer bottom: shows the 0.20 m gap under the box and anything that fell through to the world floor

render.note: z offsets are relative to the box's outer bottom height; x/y are world offsets from the box centre

contact.provenance: engineering baseline; explicit and reproducible, not calibrated against cardboard
